title: Tech View group headers show grip, arrow, avatar, name and count as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design pictures DC-08-tech-view-group-headers-light-1440.png and DC-08-tech-view-collapsed-light-1440.png are open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); they are attached to this case.
  • In the design pictures the names, numbers, dates and amounts are sample data, and the rank numbers (1, 2, 3 …) beside rows and cards are left out of this release, so do not compare those.
  • The design's group header has no pin icon; whether Tech View keeps pinning is with the product owner, so do not judge a pin icon in this case.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC08 Ines Header) is an active technician at {Location-A} who has a profile photo.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC08 Jon Header) is an active technician at {Location-A} who has no profile photo.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC08 Group Header") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17821) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17822) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-B}.
  • Estimate {Work-order-3} (for example S10043-17823) for {Customer-A} has no lead technician, so it sits in the Unassigned group.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter (if the Asset on Site chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Tech View in the display switcher.
  2. Look at the Unassigned group header from left to right.
  3. Look at {Technician-B}'s group header from left to right.
  4. Look at {Technician-A}'s group header avatar.
  5. Hover the number at the right of {Technician-A}'s group header.
  6. Hover {Technician-B}'s avatar in the group header.
  7. Click the arrow in {Technician-A}'s group header.
  8. Click the same arrow again.
  9. Click the density button and choose Compact, and look at the group headers.
  10. Click the density button and choose Comfortable, and look at the group headers.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: from left to right: a thin down-pointing arrow, a round light-grey avatar holding a grey outline person icon, the word Unassigned in dark semibold text, a short grey upright divider, a clipboard outline icon and the number of work orders, as in the design picture. The Unassigned header has no six-dot grip.
  • Step 3: {Technician-B}'s header starts with the six-dot grip, then the arrow. Its avatar is a light-grey circle with the initials in dark grey (for example "ZJ"), like "BM" in the design picture, not a solid blue circle with white initials. The name is dark and semibold, about the size of the row text (14 px in the design).
  • Step 4: {Technician-A}'s avatar is the technician's round photo.
  • Step 5: a dark tooltip opens above the number and does not cover any column header label.
  • Step 6: {Technician-B}'s name shows.
  • Step 7: the group closes and its arrow turns to point right, as in the collapsed design picture.
  • Step 8: the group opens again and the arrow points down.
  • Steps 9 and 10: the header is shorter and its avatar smaller at Compact, taller and larger at Comfortable; the name keeps the same size.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View), SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-R12, S2-R10, S2-R5 and S1-R9a, read 15 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", states core__work-orders__tech-regular__light__1440 and states__work-orders__tech-collapsed-one__light__1440 (design pictures DC-08-tech-view-group-headers-light-1440.png, DC-08-tech-view-collapsed-light-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Covers the design defects SV-11338 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Ahtasham Amjad), SV-11319 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward). Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Product owner answers: Chris Ward, WO Board and Tech View question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU), answer 16, read 15 Oct 2026. Source-verified 15 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.17-a5c4210 (staging) on 10/15/2026, before the expected results changed on 15 Oct 2026; the changed results have not yet been checked against a build.

SV-11338 estimates the design's header name at about 16 px; the ticket's estimated design sizes differ from the design file, which draws the name at 14 px semibold; this case follows the design file. Pinning in Tech View: Ahtasham Amjad asked Chris Ward on 14 Oct 2026 whether to keep the pin the PRD keeps (S2-R11) although the design shows none; no pin look is judged here. The PRD (version 52) also put a grip on the Unassigned header; Chris Ward answered on 15 Oct 2026 (answer 16) that the Unassigned header has no grip, and PRD version 54 says so.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R12: “Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.”
  • S2-R10: “Hovering a technician header or avatar reveals the technician’s name.”
  • S2-R5: “Allow each technician group to be collapsed or expanded.”
  • S1-R9a: “The switcher uses the design’s icons at 20px: List is Lucide `list`, Tech View is `user-round`, Board View is `square-kanban`. In Tech View and Board View these icons are the design’s: density (`row-height` in Tech View, `card-height` in Board View, custom icons in the design system’s icon set), collapse chevron (`chevron-down`), pin and unpin (`pin` / `pin-off`), Invoiced or Paid lock (`lock`), Unassigned avatar (`user-round`) and the empty state when there are no work orders at all (`clipboard-list`). The filtered no-results state is the List’s, magnifier included (S1-N1). The filter chips and Search use the design file’s icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it; this is the only change to List. Every other List icon is unchanged.”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), staff avatar: “Photo when we have one, initials otherwise.”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), staff avatar without a photo: “background: color || 'var(--sv-surface-sunken)', color: color ? 'var(--sv-accent-on-solid)' : 'var(--sv-text-secondary)',”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View group header name: “font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--sv-text-primary); margin-right: -12px;”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View group header height by density: “groupH: rowDensity === "large" ? "56px" : rowDensity === "small" ? "36px" : "44px"”
  • S9-R1a: “In Tech View every work order row, Unassigned’s rows included, shows the design’s six-dot drag grip at its left edge to users who can drag work orders (S4-N1). Every technician group header shows the grip to every user who can reorder technicians (S9-R2), view-only users included, because the technician order is personal. The Unassigned group header shows no grip, because Unassigned cannot move (S9-R8). The whole row still drags (S2-R8); the grip shows that it can.”
